name: Moped
description: A cycle on no more than three wheels, with or without pedals, defined as a motor vehicle; an electric one qualifies when its motor input exceeds 750 watts but is no more than 1,500 watts. An electric bike over the electric-assist bicycle's 750 watts lands here up to 1,500 watts.

restrictions.rule: No more than three wheels on the ground, with or without pedals
An electric motor input of more than 750 watts and no more than 1,500 watts; a gasoline one is capped at 50 cc
No top-speed limit in the definition
Riders need a driver's license or a moped (Class G) license, available from 15 with a vision and knowledge test
A moped licensee under 16 may ride alone only in daylight, and at night only with a licensed driver 21 or older as a passenger or within sight
Riders under 21 must wear an approved helmet with a chin or neck strap, and goggles or a face shield unless it has a windscreen
Registered with the SCDMV every two years for $10, with the plate and registration card on it while riding; titling is optional
Follows the same traffic laws as other vehicles
